WITH DISTINCT_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.partition_column} AS PARTITION_VAL
    FROM
        @{pipeline().parameters.p_src_schema}.@{pipeline().parameters.p_src_table}
),

VALID_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT
        PARTITION_VAL
    FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
    WHERE
        PARTITION_VAL IS NOT NULL

        AND REGEXP_LIKE(
            PARTITION_VAL,
            '^[0-9]{6}$'
        )

        AND SUBSTR(
            PARTITION_VAL,
            5,
            2
        ) BETWEEN '01' AND '12'

        AND
        (
            '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.p_partition_from}' = ''
            OR PARTITION_VAL >= '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.p_partition_from}'
        )

        AND
        (
            '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.p_partition_to}' = ''
            OR PARTITION_VAL <= '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.p_partition_to}'
        )
),

INVALID_EXISTS AS
(
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
                WHERE
                       PARTITION_VAL IS NULL

                    OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(
                        PARTITION_VAL,
                        '^[0-9]{6}$'
                    )

                    OR SUBSTR(
                        PARTITION_VAL,
                        5,
                        2
                    ) NOT BETWEEN '01' AND '12'
            )
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS INVALID_YN

    FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
)

SELECT
    PARTITION_VAL AS "partition_id",

    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.partition_column}'
        AS "partition_column",

    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.partition_range}'
        AS "partition_range",

    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.data_type}'
        AS "data_type",

    'VALUE'
        AS "partition_type",

    PARTITION_VAL
        AS "start_val"

FROM VALID_PARTITION


UNION ALL


SELECT
    'INVALID'
        AS "partition_id",

    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.partition_column}'
        AS "partition_column",

    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.partition_range}'
        AS "partition_range",

    '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_info.data_type}'
        AS "data_type",

    'INVALID'
        AS "partition_type",

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))
        AS "start_val"

FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1

WHERE
    (
        SELECT INVALID_YN
        FROM INVALID_EXISTS
    ) = 1

ORDER BY 1

WITH UR
